# Secrets and config

<!-- GENERATED by `work weave` from skills/secrets_and_config.work — do not edit; edit the source docs it composes. -->

Workbooks keeps three homes strictly separate: **tunable config** (a `.work` `deploy`
block, read via `Nexus.Config`), **secrets** (API keys/tokens, read ONLY through
`Nexus.Secrets`, injected at deploy — never in source), and **machine identity /
mount paths** (direct deploy injection). There are no `.env` config files and no
`System.get_env` for config — env vars are JSON-by-another-name. This skill is the
reference for getting that right.

When the user adds a knob, an API key, or a per-machine path, load the reference and
place it in the correct home.
